Universal health care access. $25 minimum wage for health care workers. $20 minimum wage for fast food workers.  Free childcare — and an entirely new grade that saves families $20k+ / year. Free community college. $11 insulin manufactured by the state. Largest state tax rebate in American history. All while growing our economy to become the 4th largest in the WORLD. California defies the punditry of haters all the time. We’re focused on delivering results. And we’re not done yet.
Trump owns the government shutdown.

Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Portsmouth, Boston, Miami, Austin — what a way to close this chapter. This tour has been about more than just stops on a map. It’s been about the conversations we shared, and the reminder that there’s so much energy and heart in every corner of this country. I’m incredibly grateful to everyone who made these moments unforgettable. If you haven’t yet, grab your copy: youngmaninahurrybook.com
Donald Trump is not screwing around. Media, corporate leaders, law firms, universities, all falling in line. That's complicity. And it has to stop. New episode with @Don Lemon out now.

Donald Trump only believes in the First Amendment when it's working for him. Billionaire allies buying up media, journalists self-censoring out of fear — this is what erosion of the free press looks like. Don Lemon is living it, and he joined to talk about what it means for all of us.
